# I. TAXONOMY DETECTION

## 1. Intersection table (OK)

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Datasets
# --------------------------------------------------

config_tab <- expand.grid(
  "Marker" = c("Bota","Sper01","ITS2","18S","REF"),
  "Level" = c("Family","Genus","Species"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Fill community composition
# --------------------------------------------------

config_tab$tax_list <- map2(
  config_tab$Level,
  config_tab$Marker,
  get_tax_list
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Split by level
# --------------------------------------------------

list_by_level <- config_tab %>%
  split(.$Level) %>%
  map(~ setNames(.x$tax_list, .x$Marker))

# --------------------------------------------------
# SAVE
# --------------------------------------------------
save( list_by_level,
  file = "~/Bureau/ADNe_Nourague_2026/ADNe_Nourague_2026_files/.list_by_level.RData")


```


### Venn diagram

```{r}
library(ggVennDiagram)
library(ggplot2)

plot_list <- lapply(names(list_by_level), function(lvl){
  data <- list_by_level[[lvl]]
  
  col <- switch(lvl,
                "Family"  = "darkorange",
                "Genus"   = "steelblue",
                "Species" = "forestgreen")
  
  ggVennDiagram(data) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = col) +
    ggtitle(lvl) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
})

plot_list
```

### Upset

```{r}

# --------------------------------------------------
# Plots
# --------------------------------------------------
library(UpSetR)

# Size of total numbers
set_size <- list("Family"=200, "Genus"=600, "Species"=1600)

# List of plots : Family, Genus, Species
plot_list <- lapply(names(list_by_level), function(lvl){
  data_upset <- fromList(list_by_level[[lvl]])
  
  upset(data_upset,
        nsets = ncol(data_upset),
        order.by = "freq",
        show.numbers = "yes",
        set_size.show = TRUE,
        main.bar.color = "steelblue",
        sets.bar.color = "gray",
        mainbar.y.label = paste("Intersections -", lvl),
        sets.x.label = "Set Size",
        set_size.scale_max = set_size[[lvl]])
})

# Display
plot_list

```
### Flow plot (type Sankey)

```{r}
inv <- list(
  T1 = c("A","B","C","D"),
  T2 = c("B","C","D","E"),
  T3 = c("C","D","E","F"),
  T4 = c("D","E","F","G")
)

library(ggalluvial)

df <- bind_rows(lapply(names(inv), function(t){
  data.frame(inventaire = t, species = inv[[t]])
}))

ggplot(df,

```


### Type time line
```{r}


df_long <- bind_rows(lapply(names(list_by_level[["Family"]]), function(inv){
    data.frame(
      time = inv,
      species = list_by_level[["Family"]][[inv]]
    )
  }))


library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)

# df_long : time / species
mat <- df_long %>%
  mutate(value = 1) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = species,
              values_from = value,
              values_fill = 0)

library(vegan)

mat_num <- as.matrix(mat[,-1])

ord <- metaMDS(mat_num, distance = "bray")

# ordre des sites
site_order <- order(ord$points[,1])

# ordre des espèces
sp_order <- order(scores(ord, display="species")[,1])

mat_ord <- mat_num[site_order, sp_order]

library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)

df_plot <- melt(mat_ord)

df_plot$value <- factor(df_plot$value)

ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = Var2, y = Var1, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("white", "black")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Species", y = "Sites")
```
### Markov network

```{r}
# ==== Inventaires ==== 
inv <- list(
  REF = c("A","B","C","D"),
  Bota = c("B","C","D"),
  Sper01 = c("C","D","E"),
  ITS2 = c("D","E","F"),
  `18S` = c("F")
)

# ==== Markov ====

edges <- data.frame()

times <- names(inv)

for(i in 1:(length(times)-1)){
  for(j in (i+1):length(times)){
    
    a <- inv[[i]]
    b <- inv[[j]]
    
    edges <- rbind(edges, data.frame(
      from = times[i],
      to   = times[j],
      shared = length(intersect(a,b)),
      gain   = length(setdiff(b,a)),
      loss   = length(setdiff(a,b))
    ))
  }
}

nodes <- data.frame(
  name = names(inv),
  richness = sapply(inv, length)
)

library(igraph)

g <- graph_from_data_frame(edges, vertices = nodes)

V(g)$label <- nodes$richness
V(g)$label.cex <- 1

E(g)$label <- edges$shared


library(ggraph)
library(ggrepel)

ggraph(g, layout = "kk") +  # ou "tree", "circle"
  geom_edge_link(aes(width = shared), alpha = 0.6) +
  
  geom_node_point(aes(size = richness)) +
  
  # labels internes (richesse)
  geom_node_text(aes(label = richness), color = "black") +
  
  # labels externes (T1, T2...)
  geom_node_text(aes(label = name),
                 repel = TRUE,   # 🔥 magique
                 fontface = "bold") +
  
  theme_void()

plot(g,
     vertex.size = nodes$richness * 10,
     vertex.label = nodes$richness,   # intérieur
     vertex.label.cex = 1.2,
     vertex.label.color = "black"
)


```

```{r}
  list(

    "Rar" = TRUE
  ))

# --------------------------------------------------

# --------------------------------------------------

  list(
    "Marker" = "18S",
    "Rar" = TRUE
  ))

  dplyr::rename(Family = family)

p <- plot_log_log(Ab_join)

p2 <- plot_log_log(Ab_bota, Ab_ITS2, "ITS2")



# 🔍 Interprétation
# pente = 1 → pas de changement de structure
# pente > 1 → amplification des dominantes
# pente < 1 → atténuation
```

### B. Annexe Table (OK)

```{r}

# --------------------------------------------------
# LOAD
# --------------------------------------------------

# Surveys
load("~/Bureau/ADNe_Nourague_2026/ADNe_Nourague_2026_files/.ab_rel_OTU.RData",
  envir = .GlobalEnv)

# Copy for modifications
df_reduced <- df_ab_rel_Richness

# Add Ref row
new_row <- df_reduced[1, ]
new_row[] <- NA
new_row$Result <- list(tab_family_ref() %>% rename(Clade = family, Metric = total))
df_reduced <- dplyr::bind_rows(df_reduced, new_row)

# --------------------------------------------------
# MODIFY
# --------------------------------------------------

# Annotate
df_reduced$Result <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(df_reduced)), function(i) {
    df_reduced$Result[[i]] %>% 
    mutate(Metric = round(Metric, digits = 2)) %>%
    mutate( `<2%` = ifelse(Metric < 2 ,TRUE ,FALSE)) %>%
    mutate( `<0.05%` = ifelse(Metric < 0.05 ,TRUE ,FALSE))
  })

# Classify
source_names <- c( "Sper01","ITS2","18S", "Bota","Ref")

df_list <- lapply(1:5, function(i) {
  
  df <- df_reduced$Result[[i]] # Select
  
  df$Source <- source_names[i] # Ajouter la colonne Source
  
  return(df)
})

# Combine
df_plot_rar <-  bind_rows(df_list) %>%
  mutate( in_bota = Clade %in% df_list[4][[1]]$Clade) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!Metric < 0.5)

# --------------------------------------------------
# PLOT
# --------------------------------------------------
ab_rel_tab(df_plot_rar)

```

## 2. Models examples

```{r}

# --------------------------------------------------
# CONFIGURATIONS
# --------------------------------------------------

i.o_conf <- expand.grid(
  Type = "bota",
  Level = "Species",
  Name = "Goupia glabra",
  Metric = c("Presence"),
  Year = "2012",
  Radius = 20,
  Norm = FALSE)

count_conf <- expand.grid(
  Type = "bota",
  Level = "Species",
  Name = "Goupia glabra",
  Metric = c("Count"),
  Year = "2012",
  Radius = 20,
  Norm = TRUE)

hyp_conf <- expand.grid(
  Type = "bota",
  Level = "Species",
  Name = "Goupia glabra",
  Metric = c("HYP"),
  Year = "2012",
  Radius = 10000,
  Alpha = 1.79,
  Norm = TRUE)

exp_conf <- expand.grid(
  Type = "bota",
  Level = "Species",
  Name = "Goupia glabra",
  Metric = c("EXP"),
  Year = "2012",
  Radius = 10000,
  Alpha = 1.79,
  Beta = 0.1,
  Norm = TRUE)

genet_conf <- list(  
  Type = "genet",
  Level = "Species",
  Name = "Goupia glabra",
  Metric = "Reads",
  Rar = TRUE,
  Marker = c("Sper01"),
  Norm = TRUE,
  Filt = FALSE)

config_tab <- bind_rows(list(i.o_conf, count_conf, hyp_conf, exp_conf, genet_conf))

# --------------------------------------------------
# GRID
# --------------------------------------------------
grid_list <- build_grids(config_tab)

titles <- list(
  "1 / 0",
  expression(bold(Count~"("~R==20~")")),
  expression(bold(HYP~"("~alpha==1.79~")")),
  expression(bold(EXP~"("~alpha==1.79~","~beta==0.1~")")),
  "Sper01 Reads"
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# PLOT
# --------------------------------------------------
plot_list <- Map(function(grid, title){
  plot_grid(grid, stems = TRUE) +
    labs(title = title)
}, grid_list, titles)

# Wrap
wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 5)

```

## 3. Correlation tab

### A. Create (OK)

```{r}
# --------------------------------------------------
# LOAD
# --------------------------------------------------
load("~/Bureau/ADNe_Nourague_2026/ADNe_Nourague_2026_files/.list_by_level.RData",
  envir = .GlobalEnv)

# --------------------------------------------------
# CONFIGURATION
# --------------------------------------------------

# Rar
rar <- TRUE 

# Levels
levels <- c("Species", "Genus", "Family")

# Configurations
basic_config <- expand.grid(
  "g.Rar" = rar,
  "g.Marker" = c("Sper01","ITS2","18S"),
  "b.Year" = c(2012),
  "Level" = levels,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

config_i.o <- crossing(basic_config,
                   "Metric_corr" = c("I.O"),
                   "b.Radius" = 10,
                   "Norm" = FALSE
                   )

config_count <- crossing(basic_config,
                   "Metric_corr" = c("Count"),
                   "b.Radius" = 10,
                   "Norm" = TRUE
                   )

config_exp <- crossing(basic_config,
                   "Metric_corr" = "EXP",
                   "b.Radius" = 10000,
                   "Alpha" = 1.79,
                   "Beta" = 0.1,
                   "Norm" = TRUE
                   )

config_hyp <- crossing(basic_config,
  "Metric_corr" = "HYP",
  "b.Radius" = 10000,
  "Alpha" = 1.79,
  "Norm" = TRUE
)

config_tab <- bind_rows(config_i.o, config_count, config_exp, config_hyp)

# Give common Names for each level
level_list <- filter_common_taxa(list_by_level)

# Expand with Names by level/marker
config_tab <- config_tab %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(Name = list(level_list[[Level]][[g.Marker]])) %>% # ajouter une colonne de listes
  unnest(Name) # transformer les listes en lignes

# config_tab %>% view()

# --------------------------------------------------
# RUN CALCULS
# --------------------------------------------------
tab_rar <- make_cor_table(config_tab)

# --------------------------------------------------
# VIEW
# --------------------------------------------------
view(tab_rar)

# --------------------------------------------------
# SAVE
# --------------------------------------------------
save( tab_rar,
  file = "~/Bureau/ADNe_Nourague_2026/ADNe_Nourague_2026_files/.tab_rar_new.RData")

```

```{r}
# IMPORT DIV PATTERNS
# --------------------------------------------------

# -- BOTA --
bota_H1_grid <- grid_read(list(
  Type = "bota",
  Year = "2012",
  Radius = 10,
  Metric = "OTU",
  Level = "Species",
  Name = "All"))

# -- Sper01 -- 
Sper01_H1_grid <- grid_read(list(
  "Type"="genet",
  "Rar"=TRUE, 
  "Marker"="Sper01", 
  "Metric"="H1", 
  "Level"="Species", 
  "Name"="All"))

# -- ITS2 --
ITS2_H1_grid <- grid_read(list(
  "Type"="genet",
  "Rar"=TRUE, 
  "Marker"="ITS2", 
  "Metric"="H1", 
  "Level"="Species", 
  "Name"="All"))

# --------------------------------------------------
# ABIOTIC JOIN
# --------------------------------------------------

# -- ABIOTIC --
abiotic <- import_abiotic() %>%
  dplyr::select(x,y,wetness,Al,K,Ca,Na,Fe,C,N,light) %>%
  mutate(CNratio = C / N) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(C,N))

# -- BOTA --
data_pixel_bota <- inner_join(bota_H1_grid$df, abiotic, by = c("x","y"))

# -- Sper01 ---
data_pixel_Sper01 <- inner_join(Sper01_H1_grid$df, abiotic, by = c("x","y"))

# -- ITS2 ---
data_pixel_ITS2 <- inner_join(ITS2_H1_grid$df, abiotic, by = c("x","y"))

# --------------------------------------------------
# RANDOM FORESTS
# --------------------------------------------------

# -- BOTA --
res_bota <- rand_for_IncMSE(data_pixel_bota)

# -- Sper01 ---
res_Sper01 <- rand_for_IncMSE(data_pixel_Sper01)

# -- ITS2 ---
res_ITS2 <- rand_for_IncMSE(data_pixel_ITS2)

# --------------------------------------------------
# PLOT
# --------------------------------------------------

## Patterns
# -- BOTA --
p1 <- plot_grid_interp_soft(bota_H1_grid) +
  labs(title = "(a)", caption = "", fill = "Spe.Rich.") 

# -- Sper01 -- 
p2 <- plot_grid_interp_soft(Sper01_H1_grid) +
  labs(title = "(b)", caption = "", fill = "H1")

# -- ITS2 --
p3 <- plot_grid_interp_soft(ITS2_H1_grid) + 
  labs(title = "(c)", caption = "", fill = "H1")

## Random Forests
# -- BOTA --
p4 <- res_bota[[1]] +
  labs(y = "%IncMSE", x = "", title = "(d)")

# -- Sper01 ---
p5 <- res_Sper01[[1]] +
  labs(y = "%IncMSE", x = "", title = "(e)")

# -- ITS2 ---
p6 <- res_ITS2[[1]] +
  labs(y = "%IncMSE", x = "", title = "(f)")

## Patchwork
(p1 | p2 | p3) / (p4 | p5 | p6)

# --------------------------------------------------
# CORRELATIONS
# --------------------------------------------------

cor(bota_H1_grid$df$Metric, Sper01_H1_grid$df$Metric, method="spearman")
cor(bota_H1_grid$df$Metric, ITS2_H1_grid$df$Metric, method="spearman")
cor(Sper01_H1_grid$df$Metric, ITS2_H1_grid$df$Metric, method="spearman")

```

### B. Accumulated Local Effects (+ To fix)

```{r}

# --------------------------------------------------
# CONFIGURATION
# --------------------------------------------------
features <- c("light","canop12","topo","wetness","Ca","Al","K","CNratio")
N_feat <- length(features)

# --------------------------------------------------
# PLOT
# --------------------------------------------------

# -- Bota --
plot_bota_features <- plot_res_by_features(res_bota, features)
p_bota <- wrap_plots(plot_bota_features, ncol = N_feat) +
  plot_annotation(title = "BOTA")

# -- Sper01 --
plot_Sper01_features <- plot_res_by_features(res_Sper01, features)
p_Sper01 <- wrap_plots(plot_Sper01_features, ncol = N_feat) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Sper01")

# -- ITS2 --
plot_ITS2_features <- plot_res_by_features(res_ITS2, features)
p_ITS2 <- wrap_plots(plot_ITS2_features, ncol = N_feat) +
  plot_annotation(title = "ITS2")

# --------------------------------------------------
# WRAP
# --------------------------------------------------
wrap_plots(
  p_bota,
  p_Sper01,
  p_ITS2,
  ncol = 1
)

```


### C. Abiotic params correlation (OK)

```{r}

# --------------------------------------------------
# IMPORT
# --------------------------------------------------
abiotic_red <- import_abiotic() %>%
  dplyr::select(x,y,light,canop12,topo,wetness,Ca,Al,K,C,N) %>%
  mutate(CNratio = C / N) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(C,N,x,y))

# --------------------------------------------------
# CORRELATION MATRIX
# --------------------------------------------------

# Matrix
corr_mat <- cor(abiotic_red, use = "complete.obs")
  
# Long format
corr_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(corr_mat))
colnames(corr_df) <- c("Var1", "Var2", "Correlation")

# Triangle (upper only)
corr_df <- corr_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(as.numeric(Var1) <= as.numeric(Var2))

# --------------------------------------------------
# PLOT
# --------------------------------------------------

ggplot(corr_df, aes(Var1, Var2, fill = Correlation)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", size = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(abs(Correlation) > 0.1, # select display corr
                               sprintf("%.2f", Correlation), "")),
            size = 3,
            color = "white",
            fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#3B4CC0",
    mid = "white",
    high = "#B40426",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-1, 1)
  ) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  labs(
    fill = "Pearson r"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y.left = element_markdown(face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
  )

```
